config.source:
SELECT
  b.sales_order_id,
  r.sales_reason_name,
  f.product_key,
  f.customer_key,
  f.credit_card_key,
  f.ship_to_geography_key AS geography_key,
  f.order_date_key,
  CASE f.order_status
    WHEN 1 THEN 'In Process'
    WHEN 2 THEN 'Approved'
    WHEN 3 THEN 'Backordered'
    WHEN 4 THEN 'Rejected'
    WHEN 5 THEN 'Shipped'
    WHEN 6 THEN 'Cancelled'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS order_status_name,
  f.order_quantity,
  f.gross_sales_amount,
  f.discount_amount,
  f.net_sales_amount
FROM fea_academy.adventure_works_analytics.bridge_order_sales_reason AS b
INNER JOIN fea_academy.adventure_works_analytics.dim_sales_reason AS r
  ON b.sales_reason_key = r.sales_reason_key
INNER JOIN fea_academy.adventure_works_analytics.fact_sales AS f
  ON f.sales_order_id = b.sales_order_id

dimensions.name: customer_name
dimensions.expr:
CASE
  WHEN store_name IS NOT NULL THEN store_name
  WHEN first_name IS NOT NULL OR last_name IS NOT NULL THEN TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(last_name, '')))
  ELSE CONCAT('Customer ', CAST(customer_id AS STRING))
END

dimensions.name: order_status_name
dimensions.expr:
CASE order_status
  WHEN 1 THEN 'In Process'
  WHEN 2 THEN 'Approved'
  WHEN 3 THEN 'Backordered'
  WHEN 4 THEN 'Rejected'
  WHEN 5 THEN 'Shipped'
  WHEN 6 THEN 'Cancelled'
  ELSE 'Unknown'
END
